headline: School Committee to vote on Interim Superintendent Contract, Assistant Superintendent appointment, school choice for SY26-27, and transfer of 10 Ditson Place.
summary: The School Committee will consider approval of the Interim Superintendent Contract, appointment of an Assistant Superintendent of Finance and Operations, MASC policy changes, reconsideration of School Choice participation for SY26-27, a Special Education Classroom Model RFP, grant and gift acceptances, and transfer of 10 Ditson Place to the City of Methuen. It will also get updates on the FY27 budget, redistricting RFP, and superintendent search, then enter executive session on nonunion personnel negotiations.
items: Appointment of Assistant Superintendent of Finance and Operations- Approval
MASC Policy Review - Approval (Section I with changes, Section I Clean, Letter from MASC regarding approval process)
Reconsideration of the Vote to Participate in School Choice for SY26-27- Approval (Member Willette)
Special Education Classroom Model RFP- Approval (Member Baez)
Acceptance of Grants/Gifts- Approval: Professional Auditorium Audio System for CGS donated by Joey Gomez
Acceptance of Grants/Gifts- Approval: Play Ball Foundation Grant for 2026-2027 School Year- $112,300
Transfer of 10 Ditson Place to City of Methuen- Approval (Member Keegan)
Other Business From the Committee: Superintendent Search Update (Member Donovan)
Executive Session pursuant to M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 21(a)(2) to discuss negotiations with nonunion personnel: Assistant Superintendent of Finance and Operations
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
